notes: Your whole chat history: scroll up and earlier messages keep loading, all the way to the beginning; jumping to a quoted, pinned or saved message loads what it needs. Group admins can choose how long messages are kept — forever (the default), a year, six months, three months or a month — under Group info. Links in messages are now tappable: Vaultline shows exactly where a link goes before you leave, and warns about look-alike or disguised addresses. Background music opens a proper Now playing panel with the track name, play/pause, next/previous and volume, and admins can set a playlist of up to 12 tracks.
